fusions.name: Spark Nip
fusions.desc: Sends a spark into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 arcane damage with a 40% chance to leave it [Mana Siphon] for 6 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Unbound Stroke
fusions.desc: Strikes the target, dealing 32 arcane damage, ignoring its resistances, and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Drink Deep
fusions.desc: Restores 20 mana at once, and you regain 12 health.

fusions.name: Spell Leech
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
